prompt: Create a genuinely excellent consumer mobile app UI design board for 'Uni Companion', a university course study and discussion app. TWO large portrait Android screens side by side, crisp readable app text, front-on flat screens, no device mockup hardware, no marketing headlines outside screens, narrow light-gray gutters. Entirely NEW art direction, youthful character-driven learning app with the precision and delight of Duolingo or Headspace. Original visual identity: electric cobalt blue primary, juicy tangerine orange mascot and highlights, clean white canvas, dark navy ink, occasional pale periwinkle section surfaces. Bold rounded geometric sans-serif typography, NO serif anywhere. Custom friendly rounded icon family, comfortable spacing, purposeful tactile buttons with shallow darker bottom edge and physical press feel, controlled thick outlines. One original character throughout: small soft tangerine-orange rounded four-point star creature, navy bean eyes, expressive eyebrows, short arms and tiny cobalt sneakers. Professional flat vector illustration craft with selective subtle dimensional shading; no emoji, no owl, no generic AI sparkle, no gradients, no dashboard KPI tiles, no stock photography, no cream/forest-green editorial aesthetic. Material Android safe areas, 48dp targets, recognizable bottom navigation. Feels designed for actual daily use, playful but not infantilizing. Fictional sample course content. Left screen QUIZ: close icon, progress bar 3/5 and question count, no global bottom nav. Heading 'What does 3NF remove?' Orange star thoughtfully holding two little database disks beside the question, small and contextual. Four large beautifully tactile answer rows with A B C D labels: 'Duplicate rows', 'Transitive dependencies', 'Primary keys', 'All foreign keys'. Selected B has cobalt outline and pale blue fill. Large fixed bottom cobalt 'Check answer' button. Right screen CORRECT FEEDBACK for the same quiz question: maintain question and answers at same positions, selected B now accessible green confirmation with check and 'Correct'. Below answers show a pale green feedback tray with happy orange star making a fist pump, heading 'You’ve got it!', explanation 'Non-key attributes should not depend on other non-key attributes.' Small 'See lecture · p. 17' link. Fixed bottom primary blue 'Next question' and secondary 'Discuss this question'. Visually demonstrate a satisfying state transition with confident restraint. No decorative score dashboards, no invented XP requirements, no giant celebration obstructing the lesson.
